verdict.rationale: Flagright documents rule instances as 'live entities' that run checks on transactions once created via the Management API, which is a configured automation running on its own. Marketing also claims explainable AI agents, a Workflow Builder, automated SAR filing and continuous dynamic risk scoring. Beyond the rule-instance API, these are one-line homepage claims with no detail on how users set up autonomous background workflows or agents, and nothing independent confirms them. Missing for 10: documented setup of autonomous AI-agent or workflow automations, scheduling and trigger configuration details, and hands-on or independent corroboration of background agent operation.
